method: Static source and execution-path review; atomscan local slow scans with --follow=none and CLEAVE_TRAITS_DIR=.; cleave facts for every input and selected archive members. No sample code executed. Fetched website assets are not part of the versioned archive. No dependency false positive needed correction.

samples.marker_line: WSH stdin loader: hidden remote eval and self-delete; traits retained
samples.identification: Defanged WSH/JScript PowerShell stdin downloader and evaluator.
execution_trace: Instantiate WScript.Shell and FileSystemObject; bind ScriptFullName.
Under wscript, rewrite host to cscript and SysWOW64 to System32, run self with //nologo //E:JScript hidden, and quit parent.
Build a PowerShell program, decode Base64 URL https://collector.invalid/agent, DownloadData, UTF8-decode and Invoke-Expression.
Launch powershell.exe with NoProfile, NonInteractive, WindowStyle Hidden, Command -, write program to stdin and close it.
Delete the bound own script using DeleteFile(path,true).
samples.verdict_basis: Explicit hidden remote-code evaluation and self-deletion; no benign operational purpose supplied. Reserved .invalid URL defangs network delivery and suggests a test or sanitized specimen, without removing hostile loader semantics.
samples.limitations: No successful retrieval asserted; final downloaded payload and deployment context are unavailable.
samples.coverage: All three accurate hostile findings retained: execution, host concealment, and self-deletion. No supported additional hostile result found.

samples.marker_line: PXT 0.12.53: upstream match; expected device access; clarify grant
samples.identification: Microsoft MakeCode/PXT core 0.12.53 Go module source ZIP.
samples.upstream_recovery: forager fetched the versioned Go proxy ZIP; its full-file SHA256 equals the original, not a reconstructed archive. Artifact and .forage.json retained under scratch/review-fallout/upstream.
execution_trace: package.json declares pxt-core 0.12.53; README describes MakeCode educational TypeScript/Blockly tools.
AppX remote-origin rules include official editor sites and localhost debug editor with WindowsRuntimeAccess=all. Four archive manifests match.
pxtwinrt/deploy.ts filters removable devices by configured target drive names and writes compiled HEX/UF2 firmware, or saves a temporary export and opens its handler.
pxtwinrt/serial.ts selects configured serial devices, reads device data, and posts serial messages to the editor.
pxtwinrt/winrt.ts handles explicit file activation and unpacks project source from imported HEX files.

external/tdast.js CompiledScript.init/reinit evaluate supplied compiled program code as part of the programming runtime; CLI build, package download, and child process calls serve the development tool.
samples.verdict_basis: Byte-identical published upstream archive, coherent compiler/editor/device workflow, and no concrete hostile behavior established in reviewed paths.
samples.trait_correction: The same declared remote WinRT grant stays suspicious. Description changed from unrestricted granted access to a declaration of all WinRT access: this is not proof of bypass, execution, or authority beyond AppContainer capabilities. No matcher or criticality changed.
samples.classifier_disagreement: Classifier still HOSTILE at probability 1.0 despite the BENIGN reasoned verdict. Accurate suspicious permissions must not be removed to manipulate this result.
samples.limitations: Review of a historical source distribution does not verify the current content of remotely hosted editor sites or a particular installed deployment. Flow graphs are incomplete for some large/nested source paths; provenance and manual tracing complement them.

samples.marker_line: Ethereum Node loader: covert decoded stage; bind child, add evasion
samples.identification: Ethereum recipient-address dead-drop Node loader appended to a database module; variant matching the repository different-eval-source fixture.
execution_trace: Legitimate front section configures Bun SQLite or better-sqlite3, initializes and migrates schema, and exports query wrappers.
After inline whitespace, escape-obfuscated imports and global aliases start Ethereum history resolution at module load.
Race public RPC providers, probe blocks near 1000-block boundaries; fall back to nonce binary search and Blockscout txlist to locate a sender transaction.
Decode recipient hex bytes, split first eight bytes into two dotted IPv4 addresses, and construct HTTP staging endpoints.
Fetch XOR-coded source via GET with HEAD fallback; a Base64 x-payload-b64 response header is an alternative carrier.
rl awaits decoded source and prepares a global-state prefix. For the first branch, eval(r+unrelated) can throw and the catch suppresses it, preventing that branch from spawning.

The second branch passes true, skips the unrelated eval, and spawns node -e with prefix plus the awaited downloaded source; detached, windowsHide, ignored stdio, and unref conceal and detach the child.
samples.verdict_basis: Covert blockchain-resolved executable source, encoded response staging, unrelated database cover code, and concealed child execution establish a hostile loader. No claim of credential theft, persistence, or final payload identity.
corrections: Move ethereum-blockchain-derived-node-stage from legacy delivery to the execution payload sink and require an immutable awaited value bound to the actual child code argument. A mere unrelated eval cannot prove payload execution.

Replace wallet/path-gated etherhiding-wallet-stage-payload-header with a behavior-based blockchain rendezvous rule requiring history queries, recipient slices, configured HTTP, header decoding and XOR. No chosen wallet or URL path gates conviction.
Add distinct hidden/detached-child objective conditioned on the admitted child-stage chain and concealment options.

Relocate all three Node inline launch atoms from process/create/inline-script to process/create/eval without changing matchers or scope. Rename spawn-node-eval-var to spawn-node-eval-first-option: the regex proves option position, not variable source. Update every exact consumer.

Move the global.i=A<digit>- prefix matcher from a malware-family identity to source-assignment metadata with unchanged matcher, criticality, scope, size gate and exact consumer reference. The three-character prefix alone cannot attribute a family.
samples.coverage: Three hostile results now cover rendezvous, payload execution and child concealment; five accurate suspicious findings retained. All source-import, decode, HTTP, SQLite, global alias and generic eval observations retained.
samples.limitations: No live C2 contacted and no final stage recovered. Ethereum recipients and final endpoint contents are runtime state. Missing sibling database dependencies prevent claiming this standalone file executed successfully.

removed_or_narrowed_claims: The old Node-stage composite could use an unrelated eval and an unrelated Node -e launch; these are not a source-to-sink link.

The old wallet-stage rule required a campaign wallet and path while asserting dead-drop delivery without behavioral query evidence. Those indicators survive as their existing suspicious/notable atoms; the hostile result now requires resolver/staging behavior.
The old spawn-node-eval-var name asserted a variable without matching one; its matcher is retained under an accurate first-option name.
consumer_audit: Old two hostile IDs have no live exact YAML consumers. Historical JSON reports remain historical.
The sole broader old dropper-directory consumer, windows-embedded-security-hosts-sinkhole, targets PE/DLL; moved JavaScript/TypeScript rules have no eligible overlap, so its population is unchanged.

All exact references to the three relocated Node spawn atoms were rewritten; no whole inline-script or eval directory consumers needed changes. Ancestor process/create selectors preserve the same observation membership.

The relocated global.i prefix has one exact family-composite consumer, updated to metadata. No family-directory selector consumes it. Existing original-source and variant fixtures retain the syntax observation; a benign tag alone gains no family attribution.
positive_controls: Original database.js retains existing shared eval/child hostile detection and gains the separately bound child-stage detection.
different-eval-source.js retains delivery/rendezvous coverage and gains the independently working child path.
different-child-source.js retains hostile rendezvous and generic eval observations; it does not falsely claim that the awaited source reaches an unrelated child.
External obf-xor-eval-spawn-stage.js retains its two original hostile results.
Ordinary recipient-byte conversion and contract-hex display fixtures remain free of hostile/suspicious findings.
Retained real font-disguised PolinRider fixture: bound child source in a comma expression restores payload and hidden-child coverage, in addition to the rendezvous.
shared_rule_review.material_detection_losses: None in the three samples or reviewed external positive fixtures. Removed IDs are replaced by supported canonical observations; no accurate suspicious detection was weakened.
